semanticConstraints: The native configuration binder merges named profile keys into source defaults and binds Paging; it does not replace dictionaries as a whole.

Profile values are validated by the owning JsonProfile constructor and selected IJsonProfileExtension registry. Unknown profiles, duplicate typed contracts, incompatible requirements and invalid paging fail before serving.
Extensions name code registrations; metadata export does not initialize application/storage/identity services.

settings.description: Explicit registered extension identities for one configured or custom named profile.

semanticConstraints: Imported defaults describe a newly constructed JsonProfileSettings value. The parent Profiles default graph describes the source overrides of the four built-in named profiles.
JsonProfile rejects invalid presets and bounds; extension identities must be non-null, distinct and registered by code with at most one selected resolver.

The required problem-response profile is projected into FoundationProblemResponseOptions at shell activation: MaxBytes must be at least512, MaxDepth at least3 and Preset must be tolerant-response. Generic profile bounds still apply; other names do not inherit these problem-response restrictions.
The native dictionary binder merges named keys rather than replacing the profile registry; profile requirements and stateless extension admission are validated before serving.
